purpose: Classify Codex app-server production-readiness questions before Phase 4 adapter hardening.

commands.result: passed; confirmed no-turn resume/archive cannot prove persisted-rollout behavior because no rollout file exists

liveTurnEvidence.prompt: Reply with exactly CODEX_CAPABILITY_SPIKE_OK. Do not run tools.

runtimeIdentityModel.codexAppServerProcess: Long-running runtime server owned by the adapter gateway. One process can host many Codex threads.
runtimeIdentityModel.codexThread: Durable Codex agent session. In task semantics, this is closest to a Codex CLI session.
runtimeIdentityModel.copilotSdkSession: SDK-facing session id mapped by the adapter to one Codex thread unless resume/tool-set policy explicitly forks or recreates it.
runtimeIdentityModel.codexTurn: One user prompt / model run inside a Codex thread. A no-turn thread may not have a persisted rollout file yet.
runtimeIdentityModel.phase4Constraint: Do not spawn a codex app-server process per SDK session. Ensure the app-server process is available, then prove continuity with persisted mapping plus thread/resume or thread/read for the mapped Codex thread.

A1_closeLifecycle.conclusion: There is no thread/end or thread/close request. Use thread/unsubscribe for listener detach and thread/archive for persisted-thread cleanup after a rollout exists.
A1_closeLifecycle.phaseImpact: Phase 4 should implement explicit adapter lifecycle with unsubscribe/archive, not invented close semantics.

A4_restartContinuity.conclusion: Codex can resume a non-ephemeral thread by id across app-server restart after at least one turn has persisted a rollout file.
A4_restartContinuity.phaseImpact: Phase 4 should stop using ephemeral threads for production sessions that require resume, or explicitly choose adapter-owned replay.

B1_C1_nativeToolsAndSandbox.conclusion: Codex does not expose SDK-shaped available_tools/excluded_tools fields. It exposes sandbox, permission profiles, config, and dynamicTools on thread/start.
B1_C1_nativeToolsAndSandbox.phaseImpact: Phase 4 should implement a locked Chatpilot lane through sandbox/permission profile/config and then benchmark native-tool suppression behavior.

B2_dynamicToolRefreshOnResume.conclusion: Upstream ThreadStartParams supports dynamic_tools, but ThreadResumeParams does not. A live resume request carrying dynamicTools succeeds, which should be treated as unknown-field tolerance or ignore behavior, not tool refresh support.
B2_dynamicToolRefreshOnResume.phaseImpact: Phase 4 must not model SDK session.resume tool-set changes as Codex dynamicTools hot-update. Recreate/fork a Codex thread or reject incompatible resume.

D2_isolatedAuthHome.conclusion: A copied isolated CODEX_HOME can start app-server and account/read succeeds.
D2_isolatedAuthHome.phaseImpact: Phase 6 can keep isolated runtime home as viable, but token refresh and 401 recovery still need longer production-like validation.

moveIntoPhase4: B1/C1 sandbox and native-tool suppression benchmark
keepLater: D2 token refresh and isolated auth longevity
